children.prompt: The north–south extent of Australia, including Tasmania; the measurement may cross intervening sea.

answer.worked: Measure the vertical extent from the northern tip of Cape York to the southern tip of Tasmania, allowing intervening sea. The map measurement is approximately $13.9\text{ cm}$. Since $1\text{ cm}$ represents $280\text{ km}$, the actual north–south extent is approximately $13.9\times280=3892\text{ km}$, or about $3900\text{ km}$.
